svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw 1205 long; deburr inside and out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plug: a 304 ring 49 outside, 70 long, holding a UHMW bush bored 40;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: push it into the near end flush and plug weld through three 8 holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: At the far end drill 10 cross holes at 100 pitch for the extension pin,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the first 30 from the end, five holes in all.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide on the 68 inner collar before the arm frame (sheet 112).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: the plug slides onto the jackshaft tip; the arm frame's far

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bush turns on this tube; the extension slides inside it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the extension tube slides in by hand its whole length.
